# Digital Commons@Lindenwood University

> An institutional repository and digital scholarship platform preserving and sharing Lindenwood University's research, archival collections, and academic publications.

Digital Commons@Lindenwood University serves as the central hub for Lindenwood's scholarly output, providing open access to faculty research, student work, archival materials, and peer-reviewed journals. The platform supports digital preservation, institutional memory, and collaborative research initiatives including the Innovation Space for emerging technologies.

## Core Collections & Discovery

- [Digital Commons@Lindenwood University](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu): Homepage for Lindenwood University's institutional repository and digital scholarship platform
- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/communities.html): Browse collections by research units, centers, and academic departments at Lindenwood
- [Lindenwood University Research, Scholarship, and Resources](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/research_scholarship_resources): Central hub for Lindenwood research, scholarship, and institutional resources
- [Lindenwood University Archival Collections](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/archives): Lindenwood archival collections including Mary Ambler Archives and historical materials
- [Authors and Works by Discipline](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/do/discipline_browser/disciplines): Browse scholarly works and authors organized by academic discipline
- [Browse by Author](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/authors.html): Author directory for discovering Lindenwood scholarly works and publications

## Journals & Peer-Reviewed Publications

- [Browse Journals and Peer-Reviewed Series](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/peer_review_list.html): Directory of peer-reviewed journals and academic publications hosted by Digital Commons

## Innovation & Special Initiatives

- [Lindenwood University Innovation Space](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/innovation-space): Innovation Space for AI, digital humanities, and student-faculty collaboration projects

## Submission & Contribution

- [Submit Your Research](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/submit_research.html): Guidelines and process for submitting faculty and student research to repository

## About & Information

- [About Institutional Repositories](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/about.html): Information about Digital Commons institutional repository and scholarly preservation
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/faq.html): FAQs covering copyright, open access, submissions, and intellectual property policies
- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/announcements.html): Email alerts and RSS feed subscriptions for content updates and notifications

## Account & Access

- [Please Log In](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User login and account management for Digital Commons@Lindenwood University

## Optional

- [Most Popular Papers](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/topdownloads.html): Ranked list of most downloaded papers and research from Digital Commons
- [Most Recent Additions](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/recent_additions.html): Recently added student research papers and academic content to the repository
- [Activity by Year](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and annual submission activity metrics
- [Digital Commons@Lindenwood University: Accessibility Statement](https://digitalcommons.lindenwood.edu/accessibility.html): WCAG 2.1 and Section 508 accessibility compliance statement
